tasks.after-register: Register the marriage and request the family record book (libro de familia)
tasks.after-paperwork: Update your address registration, insurance, bank and Social Security

tasks.civil-room: Confirm the room, date and time with the registry or town hall
tasks.civil-capacity: Ask how many guests fit in the ceremony room
tasks.civil-lunch: Book the lunch or aperitif after the ceremony
tasks.religious-readings: Choose the readings for the service with the priest
tasks.religious-choir: Talk to the parish choir or musicians
tasks.religious-flowers: Ask the parish what flowers and decoration are allowed
tasks.religious-rice: Ask the parish what can be thrown at the exit (rice, petals)
tasks.religious-transfer: Arrange the transfer from the church to the reception
tasks.dest-visit: Visit the venue beforehand or have a video call with it
tasks.dest-legal: Find out the legal requirements to marry at the destination
tasks.dest-recognition: Check how to register in Spain a marriage held abroad
tasks.dest-planner: Consider a local coordinator or wedding planner at the destination
tasks.dest-local: Confirm local vendors: photography, catering and music
tasks.dest-savedate: Send the save-the-date cards earlier than usual
tasks.dest-passports: Check that travelling guests have valid passports or ID
tasks.dest-info: Send guests the travel and accommodation details well in advance
tasks.dest-schedule: Adjust the schedule to the weather and local time at the destination
tasks.small-list: Fix a short list: only the essential people
tasks.small-call: Tell each guest personally (call or message)
tasks.small-place: Consider a small restaurant or space with a set menu
tasks.small-photo: Consider a photographer by the hour instead of a full day
tasks.small-invite: Prepare a simple invitation by message or card
tasks.small-words: Prepare a few words for the guests
tasks.small-plan: Plan a simple schedule for the meal
tasks.small-party: Decide whether you want a later celebration with other friends and family
